metadata.title: बोडोलैंड में हाग्रामा मोहिलारी के जीत की संभावना | Hagrama Mohilary is favorite in BTC elections
metadata.description: The Bodoland Territorial Council (BTC) elections saw a massive voter turnout of 72% on 22 September, reflecting the high stakes and deep political interest in the region. With counting scheduled for 26 September, speculations are rife about which party will emerge victorious. @MainBhiBharat Editor Shyam Sunder, who has been closely tracking the campaign and ground realities in the BTC area, shares his insights and analysis on who could win this crucial battle.
